utility.notes: Pioneer Community Energy's own materials confirm 'PG&E delivers energy, maintains lines, and sends bills' for its member communities, which include Rocklin. rocklin.ca.us itself refused automated connections on every attempt this session, so a direct city-page confirmation could not be independently obtained.

value.name: Pioneer Community Energy
value.notes: Confirmed directly via Pioneer Community Energy's own site: Rocklin joined Pioneer in Spring 2017, with operations beginning February 2018. Pioneer is headquartered in Rocklin itself. As a Community Choice Aggregator, enrollment is by default (opt-out model) per the standard CCA structure, though this specific page did not use the word 'default' explicitly. PG&E continues to handle distribution, line maintenance, and billing.

value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Pacific Gas and Electric Company (PG&E), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025. Administered by PG&E across its entire distribution territory, which includes Rocklin/Placer County.
value.eligibility: PG&E or SCE residential customers (general market tier)

battery_programs.notes: Same statewide CPUC-administered SGIP program already confirmed for other PG&E-territory records this session, reused as a utility-level fact.
